## Status

Development draft. No outcome analysis has been performed and no specification is frozen.

## Research question

Among US adults aged 20 years or older, is a higher baseline concentration of C-reactive protein associated with subsequent all-cause mortality?

## Design

Retrospective cohort analysis of continuous NHANES participants linked to the NCHS public-use mortality file.

## Provisional population

Adults aged 20 years or older examined in six NHANES cycles from 1999–2000 through 2009–2010, subject to confirmation of CRP comparability and covariate availability.

## Exposure

Baseline CRP, harmonized to mg/L and modeled continuously. The principal summary will use `log2(CRP)`; a restricted cubic spline will evaluate functional form.

## Outcome

All-cause mortality from the mobile examination center examination until death or administrative censoring on 31 December 2019.

## Target estimand

Adjusted hazard ratio for all-cause mortality per doubling of baseline CRP in the target population represented by the pooled NHANES cycles. If meaningful nonlinearity is present, exposure contrasts from the spline curve will supplement or replace a single summary HR in interpretation.

## Decisions still required

- final cycle inclusion;
- complete eligibility criteria;
- causal diagram and adjustment set;
- missing-data strategy;
- mortality-linkage eligibility adjustment;
- age functional form and analysis time scale;
- spline specification;
- subgroup and sensitivity analyses;
- reporting guideline.
